{{Quote|Master Kao was the most principled Jedi I have ever met, staunchly opposed to the dark side of the Force in all its forms.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>}}
'''Kao Cen Darach''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] preceding the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3681 BBY]]. A legendary [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who later held the title [[Battlemaster/Legends|Battlemaster]], Darach trained a young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Satele Shan]], who was present with him on a [[Korriban's orbital security station|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], along with [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jace Malcom]] and the [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Nico Okarr]]. The station was suddenly [[Battle of Korriban|attacked]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which had been believed to be destroyed for [[Time/Legends|centuries]], and who sought to retake the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Darach and Shan freed Okarr to help them warn the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and fought the infiltrating [[Imperial soldier]]s as they raced to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].

As they arrived, two Sith, [[Darth Vindican|Vindican]] and [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]], entered the station and engaged in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] with Darach and Shan. The Jedi Master had to save his apprentice from Malgus's [[Lightsaber/Legends|blade]] during the fight, after which he instructed her to leave on Okarr's quickly departing [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|ship]]. Darach stayed behind to continue fighting the Sith, now wielding Shan's [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]]. Darach defeated Vindican, leaving him wounded. However, he was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an enraged Malgus. Because of her Master's sacrifice, Shan was able to escape and warn the Republic of the Sith Empire's return.

==Biography==
===Career as a Jedi===
{{Quote|I had come to study under Master Kao to learn about the dangers of the dark side, and indeed I did.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Gnost" />}}
[[File:SateleandDarach.png|thumb|left|200px|Darach and his Padawan, Satele Shan]]
A [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Kao Cen Darach served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that led up to the [[Great Galactic War]]<ref name="Return" /> in [[3681 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline 6" /> Many years before the war, Darach encountered a young [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] named [[Shol Bestros]] who had refused to join the Order throughout his childhood. Recognizing the youth's innate abilities, Darach convinced Bestros to become a Jedi, and the Miraluka went on to achieve the rank of Jedi Master<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> around the time of the outbreak of the Great Galactic War,<ref name="Gnost" /> eventually serving as a member of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Darach also held the position of [[Battlemaster/Legends|Battlemaster]] of the Jedi Order, a title reserved for the premier instructor of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] among the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and served on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the years leading up to the war. But his idealism and staunch opposition to all forms of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] upset the Jedi Order's [[Politics/Legends|political]] position on the world.<ref name="Gnost" /> During his career as Battlemaster, Darach wrote a text entitled ''[[Combat Techniques of a Jedi Battlemaster]]''.<ref name="KOTFE">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=12}}</ref>

Eventually, the Zabrak was assigned to serve on the [[Korriban's orbital security station|security space station]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]&mdash;the ancestral [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the apparently defunct [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. During his time on the station, the young Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Satele Shan]] came to study the nature of the dark side<ref name="Gnost" /> and the use of a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] at his feet. During their time together, Darach trained her in lightsaber combat and guided her through her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|trials]] to become a full [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

===Outbreak of War===
{{Quote|The Sith Empire has returned. We must warn the Republic.|Kao Cen Darach|<ref name="Return" />}}
In [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 6" /><ref name="Encyclopedia" /> the two traveled to Korriban's surface to intercept [[Nico Okarr]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]<ref name="Gnost" /> who was attempting to purchase stolen [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] from an infamous grave robber named [[Farel Wickes]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Alongside the [[Republic Army]] [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jace Malcom]], the two Jedi apprehended Okarr,<ref name="Gnost" /> impounded his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Redshifter]]'',<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and took him [[Prisoner/Legends|into custody]].<ref name="Gnost" /> Okarr maintained his innocence while he was escorted up to the space station for incarceration, but Master Darach ignored his excuses. Darach questioned his Padawan when it appeared that Shan had been troubled by something that she [[Precognition/Legends|sensed]] approaching. The source of her unease was revealed when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], which had been absent from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] stage for [[Time/Legends|centuries]], [[Battle of Korriban|attacked]] the defending Republic forces in an effort to reclaim their ancestral homeworld.<ref name="Return" />

[[File:Jedi_Master_versus_two_Sith.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darach battling Vindican and Malgus]]
Darach prioritized warning the Republic of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] return to the planet, and since none of the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] would be able to outrun the [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Sith fighters]], Okarr volunteered his own [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|vessel]], which he claimed to be the fastest in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Darach, Shan, Okarr, Malcom, and another [[Republic trooper]] fought their way to the station's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], through heavy resistance from Sith boarding parties. The group eventually reached the landing bay, although one of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the process. After defeating several [[Imperial soldier|Sith troopers]] in the hangar, Darach and Shan were confronted by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vindican|Vindican]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]], who had arrived to prevent the Jedi's escape. While the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Sith [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]], Okarr and Corporal Malcom prepared the impounded ''Redshifter'' for departure. Darach held his own in combat against the Sith, but Shan did not fare as well, and narrowly avoided being slain by Malgus thanks to Darach's timely lightsaber throw.<ref name="Return" />

===Sacrifice===
{{Quote|Go Satele. You must walk a different path.|Kao Cen Darach says goodbye to his apprentice|<ref name="Return" />}}
[[File:Kao_Cen_dead.png|thumb|left|250px|Darach dead at Malgus's blades]]
After the initial engagement, Darach pushed Vindican away through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] while Okarr's ship began to take flight, with Malcolm calling out for the Jedi to join them. Darach instructed Shan to board the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and flee while he stayed behind and fought the two Sith, essentially sacrificing himself. As her master ran into the fray Shan threw her double-bladed lightsaber to him, which Darach used [[Jar'Kai/Legends|simultaneously]] with his own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to continue the battle, giving more time for her escape. Despite being outnumbered, Darach proved to be an even match for Vindican and Malgus, even managing to [[Shiak|mortally wound]] Vindican. Malgus [[Telekinesis/Legends|took]] his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master's]] lightsaber with the Force and moved towards Darach, who used the force to throw large pieces of wreckage towards the Sith. Malgus cut through the pieces with his lightsaber, jumping through the last one and launching a brutal, rage-filled assault on Darach, which eventually succeeded in slaying the Jedi Master. Shan [[Death convulsion|felt]] Darach's death in the Force but continued on to warn the Republic of the Sith's return.<ref name="Return" />

Darach's sacrifice<ref name="Return" /> ultimately enabled the Republic to learn of the resurgence of the Sith, and prevented them from being caught completely off-guard by subsequent Sith attacks. Darach's Padawan, Shan, also went on to fight against Sith forces in numerous conflicts and eventually became the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Jedi Order,<ref name="Hope">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/hope-cinematic-trailer|text="Hope"|int=Hope (cinematic trailer)}}</ref><ref name="Bio">{{HolonetOld|biographies|jedi-grand-master-satele-shan|Grand Master Satele Shan}}</ref> a feat only possible because of Darach's willingness to save her life at the cost of his own.<ref name="Return" /> Later in her life, Shan would remark in her annotations of the [[Jedi historian]] [[Gnost-Dural]]'s [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|journal]] that she felt she owed a debt to Kao Cen Darach&mdash;a debt that she was still making an effort to repay over thirty years later.<ref name="Gnost" /> Darach was eventually succeeded as Battlemaster by Jedi Master [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]], who held the position during the Cold War. Seros himself would ultimately meet his end at the hands of the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt, being succeeded himself by the [[Hero of Tython]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Rigid in his beliefs, Master Kao had caused friction in the political reality of Coruscant. Perhaps that was why he was assigned to the remote security outpost over Korriban, or perhaps he had foreseen what was to come and asked for the responsibility.|Satele Shan recounts her memories of Master Darach|<ref name="Gnost" />}}
[[File:Sith_penetrated.png|thumb|right|250px|Darach was a stalwart opponent of the dark side.]]
A hairless Zabrak male, Kao Cen Darach had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="Return" /> as well as the cranial horns typical of his species.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The Zabrak Jedi Master devoutly followed his own rigid belief system, which stipulated that the dark side of the Force needed to be confronted and defeated, no matter what form it may take. His unique, hardline approach to matters of the Force made him an unpopular figure in the upper echelons of the Jedi Order on Coruscant&mdash;a fact which did little to deter the principled Jedi. Darach's assignment over Korriban was believed to be the result of this uncooperative political spirit, but Satele Shan would later postulate that Darach's stance against the dark side motivated him to choose the assignment for himself. Regardless of the reason, Darach's reputation as a determined crusader against the dark attracted the young Shan, who hoped to learn the Zabrak's philosophy through an apprenticeship.<ref name="Gnost" />

During the battle with the Sith, Darach displayed considerable bravery and did not hesitate to enter a battle despite being outnumbered. Darach was a very stoic and calm figure, and did not break his composure, even when in heated combat. By this time, he had forged a close relationship with Shan, and was immediately able to tell when something was troubling her. He was concerned for Shan's well-being during the conflict and even intervened on her behalf during combat aboard the Korriban space station.<ref name="Return" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Darth Malgus would have killed me then and there were it not for Master Kao.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Gnost" />}}
[[File:DarachFlying-Return.png|thumb|left|250px|Darach was adept at wielding one or two lightsabers.]]
As a Jedi Master and Battlemaster of the Order, Kao Cen Darach was an exceptionally capable warrior whose proficiency in lightsaber combat was unmatched among his contemporaries.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In combat, Darach used a green single-[[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] [[Kao Cen Darach's lightsaber|lightsaber]], and proved capable of handling a Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] and his apprentice at the same time. Darach also demonstrated the use of a style of combat where he simultaneously used a double-bladed lightsaber and a single-hilt lightsaber, thus wielding an unorthodox form of [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]].<ref name="Return" /> In fact, he was the one who taught Satele Shan how to use a saberstaff.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> His combat abilities enabled him to eventually defeat Vindican, but he was ultimately overwhelmed by Malgus's [[Force Enrage|rage]] and [[Strong style|brute strength]];<ref name="Return" /> however, Malgus had been one of the Sith Empire's most seasoned fighters long before the attack on Korriban, so Darach's defeat could only be circumstantial.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

In terms of the Force, Darach's telekinetic ability was significant enough that he was able to hurl large objects, such as pieces of starships, and repel opponents during combat. His level of control enabled him to throw his lightsaber precisely and effectively.<ref name="Return" /> Satele Shan believed that Darach may have been a capable [[Jedi Seer|seer]], and that a vision of the Sith Empire's return was what drew him to Korriban.<ref name="Gnost" />

==Equipment==
[[File:KaoCenDarachsLightsaber-Return.jpg|thumb|Kao Cen Darach's lightsaber being thrown]]
Master Darach wore a complete set of armor, consisting in a suit with metal plates attached on his torso, arms, and legs underneath his standard [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]].<ref name="Return" /> Such armor design would later became common for Jedi fighting in the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Armor">One illustration in the [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']] (p. 29) features a Nautolean Jedi wearing such an armor, and dozen of Jedi in ''[[Deceived]]'' can be clearly identified as wearing this particular design of armor, including Ven Zallow, albeit in a different color.</ref> As it was tradition for the Jedi,<ref name="TOR" /> the Battlemaster featured a green-bladed lightsaber at his side that featured a metallic handle and a single blade.<ref name="Return" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Jedi_Stormguard_armor_set.jpg|thumb|right|Jedi Stormguard armor set]]
Kao Cen Darach's first appearance in [[canon]] was in the [[Return (cinematic trailer)|''Return'' cinematic trailer]], released on [[June 6]], [[2011]] for [[LucasArts]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]], developed by [[BioWare]]. While Darach had spoken lines, he was unnamed in the trailer<ref name="Return Released">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20110606|text=''Return'' Intro Cinematic Released}}</ref> and was not identified until a [http://www.swtor.com/info/media/wallpapers/return-4 wallpaper] bearing his name was later released on ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} [http://www.swtor.com official website]<ref name="Wallpaper article" /> on [[August 12]] of that year.<ref name="Wallpaper">{{TORweb|url=info/media/wallpapers/return-4|text=Wallpaper: Return|nolive=1}}</ref> Concept art for Kao Cen Darach was done by [[Joshua James Shaw]].<ref name="Concept art">{{ArtStation|username=joshuathejames|url=artwork/8ebQWx|name=[[Joshua James Shaw]]|text=2010 - Star Wars Cinematic}}</ref>

[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']], which was included with collector's editions of ''The Old Republic'', recounted the events of the fall of Korriban and included notes and images of Kao Cen Darach. ''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'' and ''The Old Republic'' were released together on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. In the video game, an armor set called Jedi Stormguard featuring a very similar design and color scheme as the one Kao Cen Darach wore in the ''Return'' cinematic can be bought and equipped by players.<ref name="TOR" /> The [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' identified Darach as a Jedi Battlemaster, and also gave additional backstory about both Shol Bestros and Darach. In the ''Encyclopedia'', Darach was listed alongside [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Ven Zallow]] under "Notable Jedi Knights", and he was also the sole entry in the "Notable Zabrak" field in the infobox for the Zabrak species.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In summer [[2013]], a [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO]] model of the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]]&mdash;titled the "Jedi ''Defender''-class Cruiser"&mdash;was released that includes a minifigure of Kao Cen Darach.<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOCite|num=75025|name=Jedi Defender-class Cruiser}}</ref>
